corrections.reason: The printed glyph in Col 1 L35 is ዳ (4th order, with a single straight right leg and shorter left leg), matching ኅዳጋቲሃ in Col 2 L07-08 (መጽሐፈ ኅዳጋቲሃ = bill of divorcement).
The printed glyph is ቈ (labiovelar, with horizontal crossbar ring at the bottom of the stem, identical to ተቈጧቸው in L10), not ቆ.
